response.justification: The candidate lacks the required C++ experience on Windows (5–10 years) as their C++ work is limited to early-career roles (National Instruments, 2014–2015) and is not aligned with capital markets or fixed-income systems. While they have strong software development experience, their domain expertise is not in financial systems, and their recent work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages. SQL experience is present but not with SQL Server or Oracle, and no Summit platform or messaging framework experience is mentioned.
strengths: Extensive software development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong background in system optimization and performance tuning
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience on Windows platform (mandatory skill)
Lacks domain expertise in capital markets or fixed-income systems
No demonstrated experience with SQL Server, Oracle, or Summit platform
